verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers a hosted MCP server letting AI assistants query events, funnels, flows, retention, and session replays using natural language, with no dashboard navigation required, plus natural-language-driven actions like creating dashboards. This is documented first-party and corroborated by a probe confirming the MCP endpoint exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the natural-language MCP experience in practice, and detail on the full breadth of commands supported beyond querying and dashboard creation.
